name: orafce
description: Oracle-compatible functions and packages on community PostgreSQL
candidateRationale: Oracle migration utility warrants further review; EDB Advanced Server's built-in Oracle compatibility is not equivalent to a downloadable orafce DLL for community PostgreSQL.

roadmap.rationale: Upstream offers MSVC/Meson builds and PG18 path, but ICU/toolchain alignment, very broad SQL/export surface and historical alternative Windows channels warrant further scoping.
